content.text: He referred to the title as "the icing on the cake" for the 31-year-old, noting that after winning Wimbledon, Queens, and Eastbourne, his former student had achieved "the triple crown."

Joe Maidment, the PE teacher, is amazed by his former student Lloyd Glasspool, who, along with his partner Julian Cash, created history on Saturday by becoming the first all-British duo to claim the men's doubles title at the All England Club in 89 years.
